mapper.sql: id, email, password_hash, display_name, plan, saves_count, email_verified_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users () VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{plan}, #{savesCount}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, display_name = #{displayName}, plan = #{plan}, saves_count = #{savesCount}, email_verified_at = #{emailVerifiedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
